context: Extracted from 10 job ad screenshots (Malaysia, RM8k-12k/month)

sectors.title: AI Engineer (RM10k)
sectors.summary: RAG pipeline with deterministic vector embeddings, semantic cache, PII redaction, prompt-injection guardrails, and LLM groundedness scoring.

sectors.title: Forward-Deployed AI Engineer - IVA (RM8k-12k)
sectors.summary: Low-latency IVA bridge connecting CRM, order management, ticketing, and RAG with end-to-end stack tracing.

sectors.title: Machine Learning Engineer (RM8k-11k)
sectors.summary: Automated ML pipeline: data cleaning, gradient-descent training, validation gating, production deploy, and drift monitoring with auto-retrain trigger.

sectors.title: Distributed Computing / Apache Spark
sectors.summary: Spark-style RDD with consistent-hash partitioning, map/filter, and reduceByKey two-phase aggregation.

sectors.title: Multi-Provider LLM Router & GPU Orchestrator
sectors.summary: Route to cheapest capable provider + GPU Best-Fit Bin Packing allocator for VRAM cost optimization.

sectors.title: Vendor Codebase Auditor (AST)
sectors.summary: AST-based vendor code audit: complexity, doc gaps, bare except, eval/exec risk, commercial readiness score.

sectors.title: Cross-Stack AI Systems Debugger
sectors.summary: Classify production incidents into Layer 1 (Infra/Network), Layer 2 (API/DB), or Layer 3 (LLM Reasoning/Schema).

sectors.title: LoRA Fine-Tuning & Failure Mode Evaluator
sectors.summary: LoRA low-rank matrix fine-tuning (W_0 + B*A) + 4 LLM failure mode detectors (refusal, repetition, hallucination, truncation).

sectors.title: Hybrid BM25 + Dense Vector RRF
sectors.summary: Reciprocal Rank Fusion of Okapi BM25 lexical + dense vector cosine for best-of-both retrieval.

sectors.title: CEC/IVR/IVA Voice State Machine + Polyglot SQL/NoSQL
sectors.summary: SQLite ACID JOIN for orders + NoSQL document store for voice session state, with barge-in and warm transfer.

sectors.title: Canary CI/CD Deployment Gate
sectors.summary: Automated gate: promote canary to 100% or auto-rollback based on accuracy >= 90%, hallucination <= 2%, latency SLA.

sectors.title: Legal, Compliance & Risk Governance
sectors.summary: SHA-256 hash-chain immutable audit ledger + multi-jurisdiction compliance (MY PDPA, EU GDPR, SG PDPA, ISO 27001).

sectors.title: Commercial SaaS Onboarding & Metering
sectors.summary: Pilot customer onboarding with isolated namespaces + token bucket quota + real-time billing accrual.

sectors.title: Analytics & Operations Telemetry
sectors.summary: Cross-functional dashboard: p50/p95/p99 latency + IVA containment rate + opex savings estimation.

sectors.title: Knowledge Transfer & Runbook Generator
sectors.summary: Automated handover blueprint: SLA targets, endpoints, DR procedures, incident SOP.

sectors.title: Python-to-C++ Native Kernel Bridge
sectors.summary: Compile + exec C++ kernel from Python (sub-ms) with deterministic fallback if g++ unavailable.
